<function name="SetDoubleClickingEnabled" parent="DLabel" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Sets whether or not double clicking should call <page>DLabel:DoDoubleClick</page>.

This is enabled by default.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="enable" type="boolean">true to enable, false to disable</arg>
	</args>
</function>
